explanation: Backtrack while tracking opened and closed parentheses. Add an opening parenthesis while pairs remain, and close only when an unmatched opening exists. Every generated prefix is valid, and every complete balanced string is reached once.
timeComplexity: O(n·Cₙ), where Cₙ is the nth Catalan number
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
